$x$ 和 $z$ 是自变量，有：

$$\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\frac{\partial y}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\left(\frac{\partial g}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial g}{\partial t}\frac{\partial h}{\partial x}\right)=f_1'+f_2'(g_1'+g_2'h_1')$$

$$\frac{\partial u}{\partial z}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\frac{\partial y}{\partial z}+\frac{\partial f}{\partial z}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\frac{\partial g}{\partial t}\frac{\partial h}{\partial z}+\frac{\partial f}{\partial z}=f_2'g_2'h_2'+f_3'$$

设 $u=f(x,y,z)$，$y=g(x,t)$，$t=h(x,z)$，求 $(u_x,u_z)$。 $(f_1'+f_2'(g_1'+g_2'h_1'), f_2'g_2'h_2'+f_3')$ $(f_1'+f_2'g_1'+f_3'h_1', f_2'g_2'h_2'+f_3')$ $(f_1'+f_2'(g_1'+g_2'h_1'), f_2'g_2'h_2'+f_3')$ $(f_1'+f_2'g_1'+f_3'h_1', f_2'g_2'h_2'+f_3')$ $x$ 和 $z$ 是自变量，有：

$$\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\frac{\partial y}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\left(\frac{\partial g}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial g}{\partial t}\frac{\partial h}{\partial x}\right)=f_1'+f_2'(g_1'+g_2'h_1')$$

$$\frac{\partial u}{\partial z}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\frac{\partial y}{\partial z}+\frac{\partial f}{\partial z}=\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\frac{\partial g}{\partial t}\frac{\partial h}{\partial z}+\frac{\partial f}{\partial z}=f_2'g_2'h_2'+f_3'$$
